nodes.label: Graphify Query-First Rule
nodes.rationale: Prefer graphify query/path/explain before raw source browsing to reduce context size and improve relevance.

nodes.label: Sentence-Aware Sliding Window Chunking
nodes.rationale: Chunking uses overlap and minimum size to preserve context continuity while reducing semantic drift at chunk boundaries.

nodes.label: Widget Security Controls
nodes.rationale: Public widget chat is constrained by origin allowlist, project secret, session token, TTL, and rate limits to harden unauthenticated endpoints.

nodes.label: RAG Queue Sync Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Confluence synchronization is queued on the rag queue and scoped by tenant and project to preserve isolation.
